question: As of 30 April 2025, the ‘GenomeIndiaA’ project has completed whole genome sequencing (WGS) database of approximately how many individuals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **GenomeIndia Project** is an ambitious initiative launched by the Government of India to create a comprehensive database of the genetic diversity of the Indian population.
 
• As of **30 April 2025**, the project has successfully completed the whole genome sequencing (WGS) database of approximately **10,000 individuals**.
 
• The project's primary goal is to map genetic variations across different regions, communities, and ethnic groups in India to better understand genetic predispositions to diseases, traits, and health conditions.
 
• Whole genome sequencing involves analyzing the entire DNA sequence of individuals, providing insights into genetic markers, hereditary diseases, and potential therapeutic interventions.
 
• The data generated from the GenomeIndia Project will be vital for research in **personalized medicine, genomics-based healthcare solutions**, and studying the genetic impact of environmental factors.
